metadata.description: YuehengHan's Claude Code mods for multi-repo, multi-session work (and a pet)

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: repo, branch, uncommitted changes and this session's /task

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: macOS notification + spoken '<repo> done' when a long turn finishes or Claude needs you

plugins.name: repo-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive git commands; asks before Claude first edits another repo

plugins.name: claude-pet
plugins.description: A status-line pet that levels up with your work and unlocks achievements

plugins.name: claude-mood
plugins.description: Claude's mood in the status line, from what the turn has read, written and broken
